summary: Local Host API, Project Loro owner for Media Assets/Generators/Documents, executable-plugin bridge, and SQLite-backed Durable Task adapter.
architecture_notes: The typecheck package script uses tsconfig.dev.json to validate current workspace source contracts. Incremental checker metadata is isolated in this package's ignored .cache/typecheck.tsbuildinfo; strictness, test inclusion and transitive source validation are unchanged, and no JavaScript or declarations are emitted.

Room inspection callbacks borrow an isolated Loro snapshot until their synchronous or asynchronous result settles; callers return plain values or bytes. Success and failure both free the temporary native document. Imported snapshot validation also releases its document on malformed input. The room-owned authoritative replica remains live for ongoing work.

Historical ACP forks carry a validated message boundary through session/fork jetbrains.air.fork v1 metadata, including server-hashed UTF-8 text and occurrence for older replay identifiers. Only verified managed adapter versions expose this action; whole-session fork support alone does not imply historical support.

ACP update checks use updates=1 to refresh registry metadata without auth/config probes. Codex startup compares saved/current models with the original legacy wire catalog, falls back only to an advertised model, and reports model_fallback in session.ready without changing global provider configuration.

Only Clash-hosted ACP sessions seed a concise AGENTS.md in their managed project working tree; CLAUDE.md, CODEBUDDY.md, and GEMINI.md are relative symlinks to it. Existing files and user edits are preserved. CLI init, standalone MCP, and external workspaces do not install this policy; their users opt into the Clash skill. SessionManager forwards authored prompts unchanged, including first turns, retries, resume and compaction. Hosted policy keeps follow-up corrections on the current task, respects planning-only limits, and uses compact scratch checkpoints for multi-step continuation. Native harness instruction loading owns the policy lifecycle; live UI snapshots still arrive through clash-workspace-context. Project identity remains in .clash/project.toml and the tool environment, never in repeated policy messages.

Host config.yaml owns global and project-specific skill installation scope. Project creation prepares the managed agent workspace before publishing project metadata; workspace preparation mounts eligible global skill sources into .agents/skills, with native harness directories as relative aliases. Links are materialized views, never a second settings authority; stale links require explicit agent removal. Legacy entries are preserved and conflicting names require a merge. Per-project setup is serialized and releases its lock on completion. Each session gets a resumable scratchpad under the project sessions directory through CLASH_SESSION_SCRATCHPAD, while cwd remains the project root.

@clash/shared-runtime owns the only Durable Run phases, retry policy, and step graph; local-api supplies SQLite journal, executor adapters, Resource staging, Project publication, and restart scheduling.

The local Host publishes one profile-scoped discovery record containing its executable runtime fingerprint and mirrors that identity from /health. Launcher replacement is serialized before a superseded Host exits, so discovery never authorizes two live Project-state writers.

New media bytes are first stored as an unsealed Host-private staging receipt. asset-inspection/v4 derives canonical byte facts before LocalResourceStore seals an immutable L0 Resource; Project/Global entries and output bindings publish only after that boundary succeeds.

Project/Global import commands carry caller-preallocated stable Asset ids. Caller media metadata is a hint only; v4 Host facts own display geometry, rotation, duration, stream presence, codecs, sample rate, channel count, and channel layout.

Provider plugins translate one submit or poll step. Production local-acp text requests now use clash.agent-text's native Generator Action and the existing ACP text-task adapter through an invocation-scoped Host capability. The shipped Agent Text Action Card uses native draft creation/editing/copy and migrates legacy local-acp draft settings; frozen legacy local-executor tasks retain recovery compatibility.

Plugin execution has one invoke/close endpoint shape. Trusted bundled modules run in-process through the same invocation schema, failure classifier, and LocalPluginBroker account/Asset capabilities as stdio plugins; the Host-selected execution realm is not stored in semantic bindings.

First-party startup reads only the closed immutable bundled-module registry and never seeds the actions directory or activation receipts. That directory remains the authority for third-party process/stdio packages, and reserved first-party ids cannot be shadowed from it.

Media execution is at-least-once. local-durable-output-staging.ts consumer-CASes one staging receipt by projectId + actionRunId + outputSlot; Project Asset and ActionAssetBinding facts appear only after v4 finalization in the publication checkpoint. Pre-v4 sealed receipts are re-verified and copied back to unsealed staging before recovery continues.
Timeline render freezes its Timeline Action revision and input bindings, uses outputSlot render:output, and recovers from the journal without client resubmission.

New Canvas Provider, Host-local, and custom plugin runs use a finalized-executor revision-scoped actionRunId and a separate mutable-node projection CAS fingerprint. Legacy base-key rows recover consumer outputs fail-closed and never reserve or project the current node.

Native Generator Project Loro exposes the immutable semantic ActionRun request, four-state public projection, and OutputCommits; legacy products expose their existing coarse status and Asset lineage. Provider tokens, attempts, deadlines, staging receipts, local paths, owner realm, and raw failures remain Host-private in SQLite.

Native generator-action tasks freeze Provider execution for media and plain-text Model outputs. Canvas media and Provider-backed text creation, draft migration and pending execution use the same Generator service with guarded result projection; local-acp is still a separate agent executor. Model Cards define capabilities and reference lowering, while Provider accounts and polling remain Host-private. Deleted or rewired placements cannot suppress immutable output publication. Completed Runs restore from Output Commits without another Provider call or replanning; Document projections remove legacy editable text shadows. Batch outputs share a Revision only when source, Definition and authored inputs agree, and retain separate Runs. Mapped Action Cards and local-agent draft entry points use the same native authoring path; native Document reference authoring and historical package recovery still require work.

Native Generator Actions use the dedicated targetKind=generator-action. local-generator-run-bridge.ts checkpoints the immutable public ActionRun request before SQLite task creation, projects running only after the private task exists, and replay-safely publishes either a verified Media ProjectAsset plus legacy binding or a typed Document revision, followed by the OutputCommit and terminal outcome. Legacy targetKind=action remains the submit-only ActionCard/custom adapter.

The Generator HTTP product surface resolves definitions from the Plugin Host, creates and reads Project Generator revisions, and submits/reads ActionRuns and OutputCommits through local-generator-product.ts. Request bodies cannot supply definition provenance, executor bindings, output contracts, fingerprints, deadlines, or execution realms; one Host builder derives the private task from the validated public invocation.

Generator head advance resolves the installed Definition for the current plugin/definition identity, validates authored state and references, and pins that contract on the new Revision. Accepted edit replay does not require a current catalogue. History and frozen Runs retain their old contracts. Host-derived edit policy and downstream placement immutability reject in-place changes when copying is required; forks use the existing create route with forkedFrom provenance.

Generator submission runs inside LocalLoroRoom.mutateProjectWithCheckpoint: the live-room serial queue durably acknowledges public pending before private SQLite creation. Replaying the same stable submission command recovers that request from Project Loro and idempotently creates a missing private task; no automatic scan of arbitrary pending public facts is claimed.

Local ACP conversation history is one Backchat-compatible append-only session_event log. Each prompt, persisted ACP event, and explicit completed/cancelled/failed terminal is stored in arrival order with its original millisecond timestamp; chat_message is not a runtime transcript source.

Typed Document HTTP commands use Project Loro as their only head/revision/attachment authority and content-addressed JSON bodies as immutable payloads. The Host derives user or agent producer provenance, validates declared schemas and exact source references, and runs mutations through the same live-room serial checkpoint authority as Generators; list/history return descriptors while exact reads resolve bodies.

Media analysis is an inert bundled native Generator. Its plugin output ports are the sole category authority; Settings, selected Run contracts, prompt versions, typed Documents, and source attachments derive from those declarations. Shared consumer-context discovery resolves semanticShape=media_analysis Cards and preserves one Card's multiple Provider implementations; plugin-private Cards never enter catalogs without a matching declared consumer.

The personal Global Asset service performs one fail-closed migration of current-user legacy assets plus asset_library_refs through Resource staging and v4 inspection; canonical entries and its completion marker commit atomically, after which legacy membership is never rescanned.

Image thumbnails, video first-frame posters, and bounded audio waveforms are Host-private derived representations. local-asset-representations.ts runs them through the shared Durable Run journal, CAS-publishes one mapping per immutable Resource plus versioned recipe, and exposes bytes/data only through entry-authorized Project or Global URLs. They never become Project Loro facts or publication gates; Timeline filmstrips remain disposable frontend caches.

The Main canvas project-card preview is disposable derived state beside the local Project replica. LocalLoroRoom debounces geometry rebuilds after durable updates; the project browser schedules one revision-keyed 640x360 WebP that composites real Project Asset bytes, while the list response carries only its URL plus the lightweight geometry fallback.

Project collaboration uses the portable @clash/replica engine with file-backed event/checkpoint ports. Desktop speaks the official Loro room protocol only to local-api; an optional reconnecting server-to-server replica link forwards durability-acknowledged updates to hosted ProjectRoom and persists cloud updates locally before ACK.

Timeline Host commands atomically import current legacy Timeline records into native Generator revisions before operating. Migration preserves Timeline and current revision identity, Canvas ownership, and media references; retires legacy draft bindings; and rolls the entire import back on malformed data or identity collisions. No migration runs in the browser.

key_files.src/host-discovery.ts: Atomic profile-scoped singleton discovery, including Host identity and executable runtime fingerprint.
key_files.src/local-processor.ts: Composes the shared engine with Provider, plugin Action, and Host-local executor adapters plus Project publication. Native Canvas requests pin a Revision and declared Action/output contract; mapped legacy Action Cards admit native revisions/Runs and retire output-node legacy input bindings. Archived frozen tasks restore outputs without the active Card catalogue.
key_files.src/durable-run-coordinator.ts: Freezes executor input and maps one executable invocation into one shared DurableRunEngine step.
key_files.src/durable-run-journal.ts: Host-private SQLite Durable Run journal and immutable validated Generator Definition archive. Contracts are keyed by plugin/definition/version/schema hash; insert-or-compare rejects identity reuse with different content. Public Project state does not own or sync this archive.
key_files.src/local-generator-contract.ts: Compiler and validator between native Generator ActionRun requests, executable-plugin invocations, exact Media/Document references, and declared single-output contracts.
key_files.src/local-generator-run-bridge.ts: Public Generator ActionRun to owner-private Durable Task boundary, including pending/running ordering and replay-safe Media or Document winner publication.
key_files.src/local-generator-product.ts: Generator product service and shared advanceLocalGeneratorRevision Host mutation. Validates revision contracts, CAS, immutable placements, and Canvas input connections. Canvas command updates use this same mutation; input pruning preserves copy-on-write lineage. Accepted single/batch Run retries validate the public request and Host-private frozen tasks before resolving installed Definitions. Complete private admission reuses frozen executor/Provider/deadline; missing tasks retain Definition-based crash repair. Changed request/account/owner/projection rejects. Batch validation forks are always freed. Creation, advance and fresh Run admission remember validated Definitions before public persistence. Run reconstruction resolves exact archived Definition identity first; missing unarchived historical contracts still fail.
key_files.src/local-document-product.ts: Host-owned typed Document create/read/history/CAS advance and attachment service over Project Loro plus immutable content-addressed bodies.
key_files.src/local-workspace-transfer.ts: Portable Workspace checkpoint/export and staged import authority: validates exact Project Loro portability, streams project.bin/CAS payloads, rebuilds receiver-local facts, and never exports SQLite topology or machine-private execution state.
key_files.src/local-speech-transcription.ts: Host implementation of the reserved speech.transcribe capability: resolves an exact frozen Project Asset, maps a canonical ASR model card to its runtime model, and validates real timed transcript output.
key_files.src/local-media-analysis.ts: Provider-agnostic media analysis through ExternalAigcService.generateText; Provider-specific wire adaptation belongs to the selected implementation plugin.
key_files.src/media-analysis-config.ts: Persistent video/model Settings and the shared executable-compatible model option/save/run authority.
key_files.src/local-durable-output-staging.ts: Stable consumer-CAS receipt for at-least-once Host-local media output.
key_files.src/local-resource-store.ts: Unsealed byte staging and canonical L0 Resource sealing; staged bytes are not readable as Resources before successful inspection. Pre-v4 compatibility rows remain explicitly unverified until one complete v4 probe promotes the canonical kind/media facts by CAS.
key_files.src/local-asset-inspections.ts: Versioned asset-inspection/v4 byte probe and L1 fact receipt used by every new Local media publication, including safe promotion of old unverified or no-MIME Resource rows.
key_files.src/local-asset-representations.ts: Owner-private Durable Run consumer for image thumbnails, video first-frame posters, and bounded audio waveforms, including stable recipe identity, SQLite CAS publication, retry scheduling, and restart recovery.
key_files.src/local-metadata-store.ts: Legacy SQLite typed-metadata body/query projection used by compatibility workflows; it is not the native Project Document Asset authority.
key_files.src/sync.ts: Project Loro owner and journal-driven wake scheduler; composes the portable replica core, local protocol server and optional cloud link. Peer sync cannot author Project Asset authority or frozen/run-owned Asset bindings. Completes legacy pending Canvas placement through shared Canvas before initial publication and peer admission; replies with the admitted layout to the origin and preserves all referenced historical geometry.
key_files.src/project-metadata-replication.ts: Capability-gated Project name/description/lifecycle metadata mirror. Local SQLite remains authoritative by default; the optional remote adapter is host-neutral and uses the same reconnect-safe cloud configuration as Loro.
key_files.src/loro/cloud-replica-link.ts: Node WebSocket adapter for the local-api to hosted ProjectRoom official-protocol link.
key_files.src/project-canvas-preview-cache.ts: Revision-keyed Main canvas project-card projection and legacy read-through cache builder; the projection is derived state, not Project authority.
key_files.src/project-canvas-thumbnail.ts: Coalesced, revision-keyed Main canvas WebP renderer over the saved geometry projection and immutable Project Asset byte paths; output lives only in the Project derived cache.
key_files.src/timeline-durable-workflow.test.ts: Timeline/local-acp/local-tts journal, restart, and output-winner integration evidence.
key_files.src/runtime/host/lib/plugin-module-runne: In-process PluginModule endpoint with exact target pinning, Host-scoped broker context, SDK-identical failure mapping, deadlines, and capability revocation.
key_files.src/provider-replay-test-harness.ts: Shared Project/Canvas backend harness for replay and live Provider suites. Cases declare model_gen/model output kind and may chain refCaseIds to a prior case's produced Canvas output nodeId, letting a dependent case (e.g. auto-rig) consume the exact node an earlier case created. The Tripo live suite is H3.1 humanoid text-to-model followed by Auto-Rig, a two-step ordered chain that is live-gated by default.
key_files.src/marketplace-feed.ts: Official Picks selection for the Home feed. It combines configured featured plugins with registry-curated skills without duplicating entries or changing upstream authorship.
key_files.src/marketplace-skills.ts: On-demand skill installation through the existing skills CLI. Curated community and provider skills retain attribution and commit-pinned upstream URLs; first-party bundled picks resolve the same canonical plugin skill directory as native agent workspaces.
key_files.src/local-acp.ts: Local ACP transport and Backchat-compatible event-log adapter; live delivery and cold replay share the same ordered prompt/event/terminal stream. Text tasks use the normal session context, wait for startup before prompt submission, preserve startup failures and timeouts, and select structured final-answer chunks when the harness supplies them.
key_files.src/local-timeline-migration.ts: Host-only atomic import of current legacy Timeline records; preserves existing revision IDs and retires the legacy draft authority only after full validation.
key_files.src/local-canvas-generator-migration.ts: Host-only atomic conversion of legacy Model and mapped Action Card Canvas drafts during room load, peer admission and normal Canvas commands. Also converts legacy local-acp draft settings to the shipped Agent Text Action Card. Reuses Canvas input compilation and native reference editors plus Model role or explicit Action port selection; preserves placement IDs, downstream facts, ordered media, exact Model/Action Document inputs, authored text snapshots and incomplete prompts, and retires authoring shadows/legacy draft bindings. Document mentions and edges deduplicate by exact revision; a newer head never changes the selected source. Missing inputs or stale bound Card packages reject the batch. Music retains separate Prompt and Lyrics.
key_files.src/local-canvas-action-contract.ts: Resolves a native Action Card only from the Host registry and validates its same-package Definition, executor, output and input mapping. Rejects ambiguous IDs and stale supplied legacy bindings; replica customActions records never grant executable identity.
key_files.src/native-text-generation.test.ts: Native Model text admission, exact Document output and pinned input revisions, Canvas publication after deletion/rewiring, legacy pending-request migration, and terminal replay without another Provider call. Replayed Document projections remove legacy text shadows.
key_files.src/native-agent-generation.test.ts: Agent text Generator submission through the real SDK/Broker/Plugin module, immutable Document publication and replay without Model Providers, plus native admission of legacy Canvas local-acp requests. The configured agent call is the test boundary; blank optional IDs select configured defaults.
key_files.src/native-custom-action.test.ts: Explicit Card-to-Generator admission, native placement execution, same-executor Action selection, native Document replay, and shipped Codex ImageGen media publication with ordered exact Asset inputs. Stale package identity, missing references, and copied Run pointers cannot reuse a different frozen request. Image generation itself is a fixture Host tool.
key_files.src/native-action-draft.test.ts: Uses the shipped Codex Card and Definition to verify blank native placement creation, CAS parameter edits, plugin Definition updates, rejected Canvas state shadows, pinned Action execution, whole-node downstream immutability, and copy-on-write source preservation.
key_files.src/agent-text-host-tool.test.ts: The named agent.text capability uses the invocation Project, refuses caller-supplied Project overrides or undeclared capability access, and validates the returned text body.
key_files.src/local-model-generation.ts: Native Model execution planning. Resolves immutable media and exact plain-text Document revision inputs, verifying stored text body digest/length before compiling Provider references. Later Document head edits cannot alter pinned inputs. Model reference binding preserves authored ordering. Maps authored audio Lyrics through the shared Canvas music mapper at execution time, validates the Model contract and freezes Provider routing without writing execution fields into authored state. New Model draft edits can bind the installed contract while historical revisions retain provenance; accepted plain-edit retries reuse their stored acknowledgement.
key_files.src/local-project-upgrade.ts: Room-load and peer-admission upgrade of legacy Model/Action Card drafts and Timelines on a detached document. Archives Definitions before snapshot publication or workflow processing. Only successful upgrades persist. Expected Asset/Generator/Timeline migration failures become a typed project.load-error sideband before socket close 1011; unexpected operational errors remain server-side. A failed room can be retried after restoring its dependencies without restarting the Host.
key_files.src/local-project-upgrade.test.ts: Real local WebSocket and persisted-replica tests for first-snapshot native state, stable identities after reopening, and typed failure disclosure without publication or checkpoint mutation.
key_files.src/project-command-host.ts: Formal CLI Project commands. Native Model canvas copy forks the exact source Generator Revision, preserves authored state and persistent inputs, records forkedFrom, and atomically creates a metadata-only placement with a copy lineage edge. Source outputs stay pinned; placement collisions roll back the entire copy. Native Canvas update adapts content/prompt, model/modelId, modelParams and lyrics into the same Generator revision mutation as the formal Generator API, with Canvas read evidence and atomic label/metadata updates. Unsupported semantic fields and invalid revisions reject without partial metadata writes.
key_files.src/app.ts: Local Host HTTP routes. Canvas REST node/edge reads, delete planning, node update/delete, edge add/update/delete and batch deletion use projectCommandReplica, the same connected room authority as Host commands. FileReplicaStore is only the fallback when no replica is injected; routes never open a sibling writer beside a live room.
key_files.src/local-canvas-generator-edges.ts: Atomic adapter for Canvas REST Asset edge add/rewire/delete and Host ensure_edge to native Generator inputs. Models accept media plus exact Document revisions through shared authoring transformations; Action Cards use their declared media and plain-text Document ports. Same-edge, same-kind rewiring preserves input slot, occurrence, prompt order and custom keyframe timing, including replacement with an already attached Asset. Preserves unplaced inputs and duplicate exact Asset connections until the last edge is removed, and rolls graph plus revisions back on rejection. Registry resolution and revision admission stay under the Host replica lock.
key_files.src/local-model-peer-guard.ts: Protects native Model placement authoring against raw peer updates. Rejects Generator pointer creation/rewiring, semantic shadow changes, and connected media or exact Document revision changes; presentation edits and pending-output projection remain permitted. Deletion uses existing whole-chain batch-delete rules. sync.ts validates on a detached candidate and frees it on every outcome before persistence.
key_files.src/local-canvas-generator-update.ts: Shared native Model/Action Card authoring adapter for CLI Host update and Canvas REST PATCH. Compiles mentions into the appropriate declared inputs, validates through the same Generator revision mutation and atomically updates placement metadata. Custom parameters remain flat plugin state. Read/placement guards stay at each transport boundary; metadata-only changes do not resolve the registry.
key_files.src/local-model-copy-projection.ts: Host-only native Generator fork projection shared by Model CLI copy and Model/Action Card Generator creation with an explicit placement source. Validates the source placement and observed head, preserves only retained media and exact Document edges and handles, and adds copy lineage in the caller transaction. Authored text snapshots remain in the Revision; Document connections retain exact revisions, never a mutable head.
key_files.src/canvas-layout.test.ts: Canvas insertion immutability and real local-replica load/admission regressions: missing positions, separate Canvas scopes, retained referenced placeholders, persisted reopening, and origin readback.
key_files.src/director-code-document.test.ts: Verifies native Stage component Document inputs, revision pinning and Loro snapshot reload after Document head advancement.

context_hints: Release compilation uses tsconfig.build.json and emits production source only with noEmitOnError. Cross-package test imports remain covered by the unchanged full-source/test tsconfig.dev.json typecheck and Vitest; tests are not release payloads.
clash.gpt-image bundles native OpenAI Images submit and Replicate prediction submit/poll for GPT Image 2.5; both use Host-selected provider account credentials.
